observed_f2_rule.rule: A pending higher-tier runtime subject may remain representative only with explicit RUNTIME_SUBJECT_INVARIANT evidence; historical runtime plus newer repository CI cannot be composed into current-generation runtime credit without that evidence.

external_primary_sources.name: Microsoft BuildXL Two Phase Cache Lookup
external_primary_sources.finding: BuildXL separates a weak fingerprint of statically known inputs from pathsets of observed file accesses and a strong fingerprint that incorporates the hashes of dynamically read files. It also tracks path probes/misses, not only successful reads.

external_primary_sources.name: Bazel Remote Caching
external_primary_sources.finding: Bazel actions explicitly bind inputs, output names, command line, and environment variables; action hashes key cached results. Current documentation warns that undeclared/untracked host tools or concurrent input mutation can make reuse incorrect.

external_primary_sources.name: SLSA Build Provenance v1.2
external_primary_sources.finding: Provenance binds build definition, parameters and resolved dependencies to produced subjects, but resolved dependency completeness is best effort; provenance establishes origin/reproducibility evidence, not semantic equivalence across successor source revisions.

external_primary_sources.name: Practical Regression Test Selection with Dynamic File Dependencies
external_primary_sources.finding: Dynamic file-dependency tracking can safely reduce reruns within its declared model by selecting tests whose observed dependencies changed.

external_primary_sources.name: DIRTS: Dependency Injection Aware Regression Test Selection
external_primary_sources.finding: Dependency injection can make otherwise supposedly safe static regression-test selection miss impacted tests, demonstrating that framework-mediated dynamic edges must be modeled explicitly.

source_derived_conclusions: A Git commit SHA or source-file digest alone is an exact-subject identity, not a proof that a successor executes the same semantic path.
A useful invariance mechanism should be framed as conservative non-interference/change-impact evidence rather than general semantic equivalence.
Declared inputs alone can under-approximate dynamic dependencies; observed inputs alone can under-approximate alternate paths not exercised by the observation.
Provenance can prove what inputs/build process produced a subject, but cannot by itself prove a changed successor is behaviorally equivalent.
Any F2 invariance proof must fail closed when dependency completeness is unknown, when dynamic selectors change, or when environment/external-tool identity is outside the captured closure.

candidate_contract.name: RUNTIME_SUBJECT_INVARIANT_EVIDENCE/v1
candidate_contract.decision_law: CERTIFY only when all changed successor artifacts are outside a conservatively complete semantic dependency closure and no selector/config/environment/tool/input-discovery rule that can alter that closure changed. Otherwise INVALIDATE_OR_DEFER.
candidate_contract.explicit_nonclaim: CERTIFY does not assert general semantic equivalence and does not upgrade the historical receipt beyond the exact scope of the proven non-interference relation.

next_discriminator: Map the contract onto F2's current WP510/WP900/WP206/WP901 boundaries and build a toy falsifier comparing declared-only, observed-only, and fail-closed hybrid dependency sets under dynamic selection.
